title: Head of Records Management
description: <strong>Make your mark for patients <br><br></strong>We are looking for a <strong>Head of Records Management</strong> who is highly organised and passionate about regulatory compliance and operational excellence to join our Global Engineering &amp; Facilities team, based out of our office in <strong>Slough, UK.<br><br></strong><strong>About The Role<br><br></strong>As the Head of Records Management, you will provide a comprehensive records management service to UCB sites in the UK &amp; Ireland, Germany &amp; Austria. You will ensure that the needs of business units, financial, legal, and regulatory authorities are met. You will manage a team of records management professionals and external partners, ensuring service standards and regulatory compliance are achieved. You will also actively engage in global records management and archiving initiatives as a subject matter expert and representative for the UK, Irish, German, and Austrian sites.<br><br><strong>Who You’ll Work With<br><br></strong>You will report to the Global Engineering &amp; Facilities leadership and work closely with records management teams in Slough/Windlesham and Monheim, business stakeholders across UCB, third-party storage providers, QA departments, external regulators, and professional bodies. You will build strong relationships to ensure best practices and compliance are maintained across all sites.<br><br><strong>What You’ll Do<br><br></strong><ul><li>Lead Records Management operations in UCB UK &amp; Ireland and UCB Germany &amp; Austria, ensuring RM policies, procedures, and schedules are implemented</li><li>Manage the archiving of data/documents and maintaining inventories in line with retention schedules and regulatory requirements</li><li>Oversee contracts for third-party off-site storage providers, including setting and monitoring service level agreements</li><li>Coordinate and support to ensure document and record control meets GMP, GLP, and GCP requirements</li><li>Manage and support the UCB Learning system for the UK &amp; Ireland Facilities team, ensuring training plans meet regulatory and business needs</li><li>Provide effective management of RM teams through appraisals, objective setting, training and development, coaching, and technical skills development</li><li>Promote Health, Safety, and Environment requirements and foster a responsible attitude among staff</li><li>Contribute to global UCB initiatives to improve archiving and RM practices company-wide</li><li>Advise and support colleagues on RM issues, promoting good practices through education, training, and practical support</li><li>Lead projects to transition from paper to electronic records, facilitate data/document exchange with partners, and enhance document management systems</li><li>Engage with professional bodies, external working groups, and other RM leaders to keep UCB strategies current<br><br></li></ul><strong>Interested? For this role we’re looking for:<br><br></strong><ul><li>Minimum 5 years’ experience in records management roles within regulated environments (healthcare, energy, financial, or preferably pharmaceutical industries)</li><li>Experience managing regulated documents and working with QA departments and external regulators</li><li>Strong leadership, interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills</li><li>Excellent organisational skills and the ability to analyse complex situations and identify key actions<br><br></li></ul>Are you ready to ‘go beyond’ to create value and make your mark for patients? If this sounds like you, then we would love to hear from you!<br><br><strong>About Us<br><br></strong>UCB is a global biopharmaceutical company, focusing on neurology and immunology. We are over 9.000 people in all four corners of the globe, inspired by patients and driven by science.<br><br><strong>Why work with us? <br><br></strong>At UCB, we don’t just complete tasks, we create value. We aren’t afraid to push forward, collaborate, and innovate to make our mark for patients. We have a caring, supportive culture where everyone feels included, respected, and has equal opportunities to do their best work. We ‘go beyond’ to create value for our patients, and always with a human focus, whether that’s on our patients, our employees, or our planet. Working for us, you will discover a place where you can grow, and have the freedom to carve your own career path to achieve your full potential.<br><br>At UCB, we’ve embraced a hybrid-first approach to work, bringing teams together in local hubs to foster collaborative curiosity. Unless expressly stated in the description or precluded by the nature of the position, roles are hybrid with 40% of your time spent in the office.<br><br>UCB is an equal opportunity employer. All employment decisions will be made without regard to any characteristic protected by applicable laws.<br><br>Should you require any adjustments to our process to assist you in demonstrating your strengths and capabilities contact us on EMEA-Reasonable_Accommodation@ucb.com. Please note should your enquiry not relate to adjustments; we will not be able to support you through this channel.

title: HEAD OF TECHNICAL SERVICES

Safety Qualification (IOSH minimum). </li><li>Certified Member of the Institute of Workplace and Facilities Management (CIWFM). <br><br></li></ul><strong>Benefits<br><br></strong>While working for G4S, you are entitled to a number of benefits and offers from G4S partners and other organisations, from employee assistance provided through WeCare, to RAC cover and so much more, including the below;<br><br><ul><li>25 days holiday plus bank holidays. </li><li>Progression, training and development catered to you. </li><li>Refer A Friend incentives. </li><li>Company pension scheme with employer contributions. </li><li>G4S Life Assurance Scheme. </li><li>Subsidised healthcare plan. </li><li>Charity work- Match-IT and Payroll Giving. </li><li>Confidential Counselling Services. </li><li>24/7 support specialising in health and medical. </li><li>Discounts on high street shops and brands including several leading high street brands, retailers and travel suppliers.</li></ul>

title: Research Lead - Evaluations
description: <strong>Company Description<br><br></strong><strong>Join the team redefining how the world experiences design.<br><br></strong>Servus, hey, g'day, mabuhay, kia ora, 你好, hallo, vítejte!<br><br>Thanks for stopping by. We know job hunting can be a little time consuming and you're probably keen to find out what's on offer, so we'll get straight to the point.<br><br><strong>Where And How You Can Work<br><br></strong>Our flagship campus is in Sydney, Australia but London is home to part of our European operations. And you have choice in where and how you work, we trust our Canvanauts to choose the balance that empowers them and their team to achieve their goals.<br><br>Fun fact, a big part of our Austrian operations is developing the AI product within Canva to help reimagine how artificial intelligence can be used in design. Pretty cool ha!<br><br><strong>Job Description<br><br></strong>As Canva grows, so does the impact and opportunity of our AI-powered features. We’re looking for a Research Lead to coach a team of world-class scientists, build on our foundational model roadmap, and turn academic breakthroughs into delightful product experiences. If you thrive in bridging deep research with practical application, and you love helping others grow while solving hard technical problems—this could be the role for you.<br><br><strong>About The Role<br><br></strong>You will lead and grow a team of high-performing research scientists who are advancing the future of AI at scale. Your focus will be on setting strategic research direction, coaching others to deliver impactful scientific contributions, and ensuring the translation of research into meaningful product capabilities. You’ll champion both scientific excellence and scalable impact, bridging foundational model innovation with real-world deployment across Canva’s platform.<br><br>This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who is passionate about cultivating talent, shaping a research vision, and partnering cross-functionally to embed cutting-edge AI into delightful user experiences.<br><br><strong>At The Moment, This Role Is Focused On<br><br></strong><ul><li>Coaching and mentoring a high-performing team of research scientists and machine learning engineers.</li><li>Owning the evaluation strategy - Design and run robust evaluation frameworks—quality, safety, red-teaming, competitive benchmarking—to guarantee enterprise readiness and user delight at scale.</li><li>Setting research strategy in alignment with Canva’s AI and product goals.</li><li>Guiding technical direction across foundational model development, experimentation, and evaluation.</li><li>Partnering cross-functionally to ensure research translates into product impact.</li><li>Representing Canva in the global AI community through publications, talks, or open-source contributions.<br><br><br></li></ul><strong>You’re Probably a Match If You<br><br></strong><ul><li>Have led research or applied science teams, with a strong track record of coaching and impact.</li><li>Possess expert knowledge and experience with GANs, Diffusion Models, VAEs, and Autoregressive Models.</li><li>Possess deep, hands-on expertise in training and evaluating generative models (Diffusion, GANs, VAEs, LLMs).</li><li>Excel at creating data-driven evaluation methodologies, turning user analytics into clear, actionable insights.</li><li>Bring strategic thinking and scientific rigour to project direction and problem solving.</li><li>Thrive in collaborative environments and communicate clearly with technical and non-technical audiences.</li><li>Stay current with research trends and are energised by continuous learning.<br><br><br></li></ul><strong>Additional Information<br><br></strong><strong>What's in it for you?<br><br></strong>Achieving our crazy big goals motivates us to work hard - and we do - but you'll experience lots of moments of magic, connectivity and fun woven throughout life at Canva, too. We also offer a stack of benefits to set you up for every success in and outside of work.<br><br><strong>Here's a Taste Of What's On Offer<br><br></strong><ul><li>Equity packages - we want our success to be yours too</li><li>Inclusive parental leave policy that supports all parents &amp; carers</li><li>An annual Vibe &amp; Thrive allowance to support your wellbeing, social connection, home office setup &amp; more</li><li>Flexible leave options that empower you to be a force for good, take time to recharge and supports you personally<br><br><br></li></ul>Check out lifeatcanva.com for more info.<br><br><strong>Other Stuff To Know<br><br></strong>We make hiring decisions based on your experience, skills and passion, as well as how you can enhance Canva and our culture. When you apply, please tell us the pronouns you use and any reasonable adjustments you may need during the interview process.<br><br>Please note that interviews are predominantly conducted virtually.

title: Head of Technical Services

mandatory compliance expertise</li><li>Strong commercial and financial acumen</li><li>Influential leader and change driver</li><li>Skilled stakeholder and relationship builder</li><li>Customer-focused and delivery-oriented</li><li>Able to manage complexity and embed continuous improvement</li></ul><p><br></p><p><strong>Skills &amp; title: Head of Technical Program Management - Networks

title: Engineering Manager | Convert & Scale
description: <strong>Meet DeepL<br><br></strong>DeepL is a global communications platform powered by Language AI. Since 2017, we’ve been on a mission to break down language barriers. Our human-sounding translations and intelligent writing suggestions are designed with enterprise security in mind. Today, they enable over 100,000 businesses to transform communications, reach new markets, and improve productivity. And, empower millions of individuals worldwide to make sense of the world and express their ideas.<br><br>Our goal is to become the global leader in Language AI, building products that drive better communication, foster connections, and make a real-life impact. To achieve this, we need talented individuals like you to join our exciting journey. If you're ready to work with a dynamic team and build your career in the fast-moving AI space, DeepL is your next destination.<br><br><strong>What Sets Us Apart<br><br></strong>What sets us apart is our blend of modern technology, competitive benefits, and an open, welcoming work culture that enables our people to thrive. When we share what it's like to work at DeepL, the reactions are overwhelmingly positive. This may be because of our products that have helped countless people worldwide or our shared mission to improve communication for individuals and businesses, bringing cultures closer together. What we know for sure is this: being part of DeepL means joining a team dedicated to innovation and employee well-being. Discover what our teams have to say about life at DeepL on LinkedIn, Instagram and our Blog.<br><br><strong>Meet the team behind this journey<br><br></strong>You will be joining the CAST (Convert and Scale) track, a division of our business that has recently seen increased strategic investment and realignment. You will lead the Identity and Access team, a core platform team responsible for building and scaling the services that power our entire customer ecosystem.<br><br>This team’s domain is central to our business, covering everything from Single Sign-On (SSO) and account management to identity provider (IDP) integration, logins, and session management. As a platform team, your primary customers are other engineering teams at DeepL. You will partner closely with a Technical Product Manager and collaborate with teams like Account and Team Experience and Business Platform to deliver foundational features that enable a secure, scalable, and frictionless experience for all DeepL users.<br><br><strong>Your Responsibilities<br><br></strong><ul><li>People Leadership: Lead, mentor, and grow a talented, UK-based distributed team of 7 senior and intermediate engineers. You will be responsible for their well-being and growth through regular 1:1s, continuous feedback, performance reviews, and dedicated career development coaching.</li><li>Execution &amp; Delivery: Own the team's execution and delivery, establishing a predictable cadence using agile methodologies. You will partner with your Technical Product Manager to define, refine, and deliver the quarterly roadmap, ensuring the team's work aligns with strategic business goals.</li><li>Technical Guidance: Act as the team's technical steward. While this is a 0-10% hands-on coding role, your strong engineering background is crucial. You will guide architectural discussions, review system designs, and uphold high standards for quality, scalability, security, and other non-functional requirements.</li><li>Project &amp; Strategic Ownership: Take ownership of the team's strategic bets. Your first key projects will include delivering our SCIM (System for Cross-domain Identity Management) rollout and device-based authentication, both critical for our enterprise customers.</li><li>Stakeholder Management: Serve as the team's primary representative in planning and technical discussions. You will clearly articulate technical trade-offs and build strong relationships with stakeholders across product, engineering, and the wider business.</li><li>Participation in our on-call rotation: You’ll ensure the reliability and availability of our services by being available to join the team's shared on-call rotation as needed.<br><br></li></ul><strong>Qualities we look for<br><br></strong><strong>Must-Haves<br><br></strong><ul><li>People management experience - ideally 3+ years of direct people management experience, leading a team of 5 - 10 engineers.</li><li>Strong technical foundation - 5+ years of hands-on experience as a Senior or Staff-level engineer, with expertise in C# (or strong, transferable experience in Java).</li><li>Distributed systems design - Proven experience designing, building, and operating scalable, highly available distributed systems.</li><li>Modern tech stack experience - Demonstrable experience with cloud platforms (preferably AWS), containerisation (Docker, Kubernetes), and API design (gRPC, REST).</li><li>Database expertise - Hands-on experience with both relational databases (like PostgreSQL) and NoSQL databases (like Cassandra).</li><li>A "People-First" approach - A deep commitment to the growth and well-being of your team, with proven experience in coaching, mentorship, and performance management.</li><li>Strong execution - A focus on execution and delivery, with a pragmatic approach to balancing technical excellence with the practical need to ship value.</li><li>Excellent problem-solver - The ability to break down complex, ambiguous problems into concrete, actionable steps for your team.</li><li>Clear communicator - Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to articulate technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.<br><br></li></ul><strong>Nice-to-Haves<br><br></strong><ul><li>Domain Knowledge - Experience in the Identity and Access Management (IAM) domain (e.g., SSO, OAuth, SCIM, OIDC).</li><li>Event-Driven systems - Demonstrated experience with event-based processing and messaging systems like Kafka.</li><li>Hiring experience -Proven experience hiring and onboarding software engineers in a distributed team environment.</li><li>DevOps &amp; Scaling -Strong experience with DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure scaling, and cloud migration.<br><br></li></ul><strong>What We Offer<br><br></strong><ul><li>Diverse and internationally distributed team: joining our team means becoming part of a large, global community with people of more than 90 nationalities. We're more than just colleagues; we're a group of professionals with a shared mission to connect diverse cultures. Our global presence is growing–we've doubled in size nearly every year, with our employees based in the UK, Germany, the Netherlands, Poland, the US, and Japan, and we continue to expand our network.</li><li>Open communication, regular feedback: as a language-focused company, we value the importance of clear, honest communication. We value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and growth mindset makes us better together.</li><li>Hybrid work, flexible hours: we offer a hybrid work schedule, with team members coming into the office twice a week. This allows you to engage directly with your team and experience the unique energy of our workspace, while still enjoying the flexibility and comfort of working from home. With flexible working hours and trust in your productivity, we are in sync with your team’s general locations and time zones to foster effective and seamless collaboration.</li><li>Virtual Shares - An ownership mindset in every role. We believe everyone should share in our success, and that’s why every employee receives Virtual Shares, linking your contribution directly to DeepL’s growth and rewarding you with a stake in our future.</li><li>Regular in-person team events: we bond over vibrant events that are as unique as our team, from local team and business unit gatherings, to new-joiner onboardings, to company-wide events that bring us all together–literally.</li><li>Monthly full-day hacking sessions: every month, we have Hack Fridays, where you can spend your time diving into a project you're passionate about and get the opportunity to work with other teams–we value your initiatives, impact, and creativity.</li><li>30 days of annual leave: we value your peace of mind. With 30 days off (excluding public holidays) and access to mental health resources, we make sure you're as strong mentally as you are professionally.</li><li>Competitive benefits: just as our team spans the globe, so does our benefits package. We've crafted it to reflect the diversity of our team and tailored it to align with your unique location, to ensure you feel supported every step of the way.<br><br></li></ul>If this role and our mission resonate with you, but you're hesitant because you don't check all the boxes, don't let that hold you back. At DeepL, it's all about the value you bring and the growth we can foster together. Go ahead, apply—let's discover your potential together. We can't wait to meet you!<br><br><strong>We are an equal opportunity employer<br><br></strong>You are welcome at DeepL for who you are—we appreciate authenticity here. Our product is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all succeed, contribute, and think forward! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our diversity that we will find the power to break down language barriers in the world.
